name: Muwaffaq al-Dīn Abū al-Baqāʾ Yaʿīsh ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaʿīsh al-Ḥalabī
summary: The grammarian of Aleppo whose Sharḥ al-Mufaṣṣal, a full commentary on al-Zamakhsharī's grammar, is one of the great reference works of naḥw.
bio: Ibn Yaʿīsh was born in Aleppo in 553/1158, studied there and in Mosul and Damascus, and taught in Aleppo for most of his long life; Ibn Khallikān, who studied with him there, describes his teaching and his gentleness with students. Ibn Mālik is said to have attended his lessons.

His Sharḥ al-Mufaṣṣal explains al-Zamakhsharī's al-Mufaṣṣal section by section, giving for each rule the reasons, the evidence and the views of the Basrans and the Kufans; printed in ten volumes, it is still the place where students look up a question. He also wrote a commentary on Ibn Jinnī's al-Taṣrīf al-mulūkī. He died in Aleppo in 643/1245.

sources.title: İbn Yaîş, Ebü'l-Bekā, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
